readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on a cold executable whole line inside a reached range. The omitted single-line arms are defensive: total publication ineligibility and a blocked identity mint. Direct coordinator tests pin empty and fail-closed paths, retained group evidence, publication eligibility and legacy gating, QCD committed-source precedence, executor request/source order, candidate-liability and funding-vector identity, exact movement/member construction, and input purity. Existing full-simulator linked-group tests exercise a settled non-null Form 8606 character; the hostile delegation test separately injects non-economic objects and proves exact YearResult publication without caller-side rebuilding.
